text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

In the narrative, the melody serves as a rhythmic motif, much like the steady, unceasing beat of the heart. Just as the heart pumps blood to sustain life and connect every part of the body, the melody circulates through the community, connecting disparate lives and sustaining their shared humanity. The haunting nature of the tune mirrors the vital, often unnoticed pulse that keeps the social fabric alive, reminding us that beneath the surface of individual stories lies a common, rhythmic current of experience that binds them together.
